Classics

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Classics at Radboud studies ancient Greek and Latin languages, literature and culture. Students read and translate original texts and study ancient history, archaeology and literary research.

UCR offers related courses in Greek archaeology, ancient democracy, mythology, rhetoric and philosophy. These are valuable connections, but the available courses do not support a complete programme centred on Greek and Latin language and original-text study. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary domestic pathway

The 180-EC programme comprises 120 EC of required study, 30 EC of restricted Arts minors and 30 EC of open study. The pathway shown assumes school-level Greek and Latin. Where needed, language intensification replaces a first texts course. Mentorship, academic Dutch assessment and the thesis colloquium are also required zero-credit activities.
